lines.en: I drift forward half a block off the ground
My robe twists in the updraft

lines.zh: 老朽的身躯照样飞得稳
lines.en: This old body still flies steady

lines.zh: 我贴着地面滑过一片影子
lines.en: I skim a shadow across the ground

lines.zh: 紫色的手背在袖里握紧
lines.en: My purple hands clench inside the sleeves

lines.zh: 我慢慢升高到树梢高度
lines.en: I rise slowly to treetop height

lines.zh: 飞行时连尘土都不惊动
lines.en: My flight does not even stir the dust
I circle the ruins
Three hundred years, and still I fly
I drop lower toward the ground
I hang motionless in the air
Only half my face shows under the hat
I wait for my strength to return

lines.zh: 手指一根根松开又握紧
lines.en: My fingers loosen and clench one by one
This body of mine ages fast
Wind passes through my sleeve
I look down at my own palm
I cough twice, lightly
The color of the sky displeases me
I lift my chin slightly
A breath coils in my chest

lines.zh: 我在算自己还剩多少年
lines.en: I am counting how many years I have left
I press my hat down a little

lines.zh: 我的气在体内缓缓流动
lines.en: My ki drifts slowly through my body
I watch my own shadow

lines.zh: 老年的我飞得比走得快
lines.en: Old as I am, flying beats walking

lines.zh: 你这样的年纪，也敢站在我面前
lines.en: At your age, you dare stand before me

lines.zh: 我认得你眼里的那种光
lines.en: I know that look in your eyes

lines.zh: 三百年的魔王，见过太多人
lines.en: Three hundred years of a Demon King, I have seen too many
You do not look like you came to beg
I tip my hat brim to look at you
Your ki, I see right through it

lines.zh: 老魔王的脸，看了会做噩梦。
lines.en: The old demon king's face gives nightmares.
My hand has not left my sleeve
Stand further off, I hate looking up

lines.zh: 你说的每个字我都听见了
lines.en: I heard every word you said

lines.zh: 年轻人的胆子总是很足
lines.en: The young are always so bold
I took a hit and fell back half a foot
This old body reacts slowly
I wipe a bit of blood from my lip
Interesting, you actually landed it

lines.zh: 我闪身时还是晚了半分
lines.en: Even my dodge was half a beat late
The pain sharpens me

lines.zh: 我的袍子被撕开一道口
lines.en: A slit is torn in my robe
You are green, but not entirely

lines.zh: 我这把老骨头还撑得住。
lines.en: These old bones can still take it.

lines.zh: 老了，就是会流这么多血
lines.en: Old age means bleeding this much
Food means little to me
You use this to test me
I smell nothing special
Put it away, do not embarrass yourself

lines.zh: 我这一生没为吃低过头
lines.en: I have never bowed my head for food

lines.zh: 你手举着的样子很可笑
lines.en: The way you hold it up is laughable

lines.zh: 我倒要看看你想做什么
lines.en: Let me see what you are up to
This temptation is childish
I did not even raise an eyelid
Take it away, I want to talk business
Your strength cannot move me
My sleeve brushed your shoulder
I drifted half a block aside
Do not touch my robe

lines.zh: 我们之间的距离由我定
lines.en: I decide the distance between us

lines.zh: 你撞上来的时候我笑了
lines.en: I smiled when you bumped into me
This bump is no fight
I dropped half an inch and steadied
Your bones are harder than they look
Move, you are blocking my airflow
This has nothing to do with me
I am long past that age
A Demon King needs no companion
I turn my face away

lines.zh: 我的后代自有我的安排
lines.en: My offspring have their own place in my plans
I will say this only once
You ask too much

lines.zh: 孤独是三百年的一部分
lines.en: Solitude is part of three hundred years

lines.zh: 我不需要谁站在我身边
lines.en: I need no one at my side
There is no need to raise it again
I reach out and pinch it up
Is this worth picking up
I pinch it and study it

lines.zh: 掉在地上的，我未必稀罕
lines.en: What falls to the ground, I may not want
This thing is of no use at all
It disappears up my sleeve
I will keep this, it has a use
I look at it, then toss it aside

lines.zh: 这片地上的一切都曾属于我
lines.en: Everything on this ground was once mine

lines.zh: 我老了，气却压得你喘不过。
lines.en: I am old, but my ki still crushes you.
I see it, you are trembling
Lift your head and let me see you
This distance is just right
I wait for your first step
Your openings are all in your footing
I raise my ki into my palm

lines.zh: 很好，我久违地来了兴致
lines.en: Good, I am finally interested

lines.zh: 三百年没遇到像样的对手
lines.en: Three hundred years without a worthy opponent
I raise one hand slowly

lines.zh: 你的每一寸骨节我都算清了
lines.en: I have calculated every joint of yours
This sky is my battlefield
I lower myself and the airflow spreads
I will not underestimate you this time
Let me see how long you hold out
One corner of my mouth lifts

lines.zh: 机会只有一次，我会用尽
lines.en: There is one chance, and I will use it fully
I stay hovering above you

lines.zh: 你每次移动我都跟着偏一点
lines.en: Each time you move, I shift a little

lines.zh: 气功的力量已经聚在指间
lines.en: The ki is already gathered at my fingers
I am waiting for you to show your back
You step back an inch, I advance a foot
Do not think of slipping past my eyes
I have your landing spot worked out
The airflow spirals around my hand
Your speed is far from enough

lines.zh: 我压低呼吸听着你的脚步
lines.en: I lower my breathing and listen to your steps
I am in no hurry to end this

lines.zh: 在我的空中，你无处可逃
lines.en: In my sky you have nowhere to run
Every raise of my hand gathers power
I let my ki slowly close around you

lines.zh: 你抬头看我的时候就是破绽
lines.en: The moment you look up is your opening
I wait for that moment
I know this airspace well
You will be the first to tire

lines.zh: 我从不追着人跑，我等着人过来
lines.en: I never chase, I wait for them to come
My knee drives into your chest
Four blows in one aerial combo
A ki laser fires from my fingers
I press a palm onto your shoulder
The combo has not a single pause

lines.zh: 这一肘藏在上一掌后面
lines.en: This elbow hides behind the last palm
A ki blast chases along the ground

lines.zh: 我抓住你的手腕再甩开
lines.en: I grab your wrist and throw you off

lines.zh: 你的防御被我打开了一个口
lines.en: Your guard has one gap open
I retreat right after landing the hit

lines.zh: 这一下是三百年的分量
lines.en: That one carries three hundred years
My palm wind is faster than a blade

lines.zh: 你听见声音时已经晚了
lines.en: You heard it too late

lines.zh: 一次出手就够决定胜负
lines.en: One exchange is enough to decide it
I rise out of the shadow

lines.zh: 这一身老骨头，还能再战
lines.en: These old bones can fight again
The three-hundred-year Demon King has returned
My ki presses down first
The sky gives a muffled thunder

lines.zh: 帽檐下那双眼睛睁开了
lines.en: The eyes under the hat brim open

lines.zh: 地面上的草木低了一寸
lines.en: The grass on the ground bends an inch lower
I hover right in front of you
No one called me, yet here I am

lines.zh: 我的力量还没回到顶点
lines.en: My strength has not returned to its peak
I know this ground

lines.zh: 我把袖子一抖，尘土散开
lines.en: I shake my sleeve and the dust scatters
Stand up, do not kneel

lines.zh: 我这一生从未输给时间
lines.en: I have never lost to time
My arrival always brings silence

lines.zh: 我来看看这个世界还剩下什么
lines.en: I have come to see what is left of this world
I exhale and the cloud parts
Your breathing is too loud
I settle slowly before you

lines.zh: 从今天起，这地方我记得
lines.en: From today, I remember this place
Flames are eating my robe hem

lines.zh: 我从空中被砸落了一段
lines.en: I was smashed down a stretch through the air

lines.zh: 水淹到我的帽檐，很难受
lines.en: Water reached my hat brim, most unpleasant

lines.zh: 爆炸把我的气流都掀散了
lines.en: The blast scattered my airflow

lines.zh: 一枚弹丸打穿了我的袖子
lines.en: A shot tore through my sleeve

lines.zh: 那股咒力想钻进我的气里
lines.en: That magic tried to worm into my ki

lines.zh: 我太久没进食了，力气在退
lines.en: I have not fed in too long, my strength recedes

lines.zh: 雷劈在我身上，袍子冒烟
lines.en: Lightning struck me and my robe smokes
I fell where there is no sky
